subject: BridgeLane throughput surge - RCA & action plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@bridgelane.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: BridgeLane throughput surge - RCA & action plan

Samir,

Thanks again for the bridge this morning. Per our promise during the call, attached is the preliminary RCA and the proposed corrective-action checklist we will run over the next 72 hours. High-level summary:

- Root cause: an unexpected KV-cache invalidation cascade during a long-tailed prefix distribution caused increased token generation on the Dedicated pool serving your routes, which amplified scheduling overhead and pushed queue latency past the SLA window.
- Impact window: 2028-03-24 03:12 - 2028-03-24 04:03 UTC; 6-8% increase in  p50->p95 token latency and a 12% bump in 5xx error observations for routed requests.
- Immediate mitigations applied: reverted recent batching policy change for the affected model variant and applied a soft-prefetch limiter on the pool.

What we are delivering now:
- Attached: BridgeLane_RCA_20280327.pdf (formal RCA), remediation-checklist-bridgeLane.xlsx (owners & deadlines), and a short log excerpt (SUP-4219-postmortem-notes.txt).

As discussed, we propose:
1) A 3-day remediation sweep (owners & checkpoints in the spreadsheet).
2) Daily 11:00am PT status updates to your ops & engineering leads.
3) Executive readout on Friday 03/30 at 10:00am PT if you want to confirm closure and any service credits.

Next steps from our side: Marissa will own the day-to-day remediation cadence; Karthik will validate kernel selection changes and run performance regression tests; I will coordinate the exec readout.

Please confirm if the 10:00am PT Friday slot works for you and whether you need any additional items in the RCA.

Regards,

Logan Wright
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BridgeLane_RCA_20280327.pdf (application/pdf), remediation-checklist-bridgeLane.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Samir Desai <samir@bridgelane.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Reddy <maya@bridgelane.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeLane throughput surge - RCA & action plan

Logan —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the level of detail. A couple quick items from our side:

- Appreciate the RCA. The initial impact had meaningful customer-visible slowdowns on checkout search for roughly 45 minutes; we logged a handful of aborted sessions and a noticeable drop in conversions during that window.
- We need daily status emails to both ops and a single exec sponsor. Can Kimberly Park (your head of customer success) be added to the Friday readout — our VP of Engineering wants an executive present to discuss credits.

Two asks right now:
1) Please add an estimated timeline for the kernel-level validation (we need confidence that the fix won’t regress other models).
2) Please include the delta on our monthly token billing for the impacted window (so we can estimate potential credits).

We’ll confirm Friday 10:00am PT as long as Kimberly can join.

—Samir
Samir Desai
Director, Platform Engineering
BridgeLane Retail
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@bridgelane.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeLane throughput surge - RCA & action plan

Looping in initial owners and short assignments.

Karthik — can you please populate the remediation spreadsheet with the kernel validation timeline by EOD today? Include expected test matrices and a rollback plan.

I'll stand up the daily status note and send the first one tomorrow morning 11:00am PT. I’ll also attach a short internal runbook for the on-call engineers so they have a clear checklist when we hit regression gates.

Samir — we’ll include a conservative token delta estimate in tomorrow’s status note; the procurement team has asked that we flag any credit recommendation up front.

Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@bridgelane.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeLane throughput surge - RCA & action plan

Marissa / Logan —

Short update: I ran the initial kernel validation matrix against a non-production clone of the BridgeLane model variant. Findings:

- Candidate kernel update reduces mean generator overhead by ~9% in our synthetic traces at target sequence lengths; no HTTP 5xx observed in the test harness.
- Two regression risk areas to validate: (a) quantization path for long prefix sequences, (b) KV-cache warmup under mixed-batch traffic.

Planned next steps and ETA:
- Wed 03/28 02:00 - 06:00 PT: extended stress window in staging with traffic replay (owner: Karthik).
- Thu 03/29 09:00 - 12:00 PT: post-stress validation + rollback rehearsal (owner: Marissa).
- Fri 03/30 10:00 PT: exec readout (owner: Logan) + decision on closure.

I will upload the detailed test logs to SUP-4219 and mark the remediation checklist with the owner/time estimates.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

1) Brief RCA recap (5m)
2) Mitigations applied & test results (10m)
3) Proposed closure and residual risk (10m)
4) Credits & commercial remediation (10m)
5) Q&A and action items (15m)

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/8923741234

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@bridgelane.com>, Maya Reddy <maya@bridgelane.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgeLane throughput surge - RCA & action plan

Samir —

Thank you for joining the readout today and for the clear context on commercial impact. Per the discussion:

- Redwood will issue a token-level credit covering estimated overage during the impact window. Finance will prepare a formal credit memo and send it by Tue 04/02.
- Technical closure: Karthik’s kernel update passed the staging stress tests; we will monitor production for 14 days with mandatory daily health snapshots and an escalation trigger if p95 latency increases by more than 8% relative to the week prior.
- Action items assigned (finalized in remediation-checklist-bridgeLane.xlsx):
  * Karthik — complete rollout validation and post-deploy tests (ETA: 2028-04-03).
  * Marissa — daily status notes to BridgeLane & internal remediation standups (daily 11:00am PT through 2028-04-10).
  * Logan — track exec follow-through and confirmation of credit memo (ETA: 2028-04-02).

We appreciate BridgeLane’s partnership; we’ll keep the communication tight until the monitoring window closes.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
